verdict.rationale: The Drive API's documented permissions resource lets developers grant access by type (user, group, domain, anyone) and role on every file, folder and shared drive. That covers programmable link visibility and access level. Nothing in the evidence documents password protection or expiry on shared links, and revocation through the API is only implied. Missing for 10: password-protected links, link expiry settings, explicitly documented revoke/delete of permissions, independent corroboration.
